description: This source file implements APIs for managing external SD Card properties within a TR-069 host interface, including retrieving SD card information such as capacity, manufacturer, model, serial number, status, and other attributes. It includes class definitions, singleton pattern implementation, and platform-specific code for SD card property retrieval.

classes.name: hostIf_STBServiceXSDCard
classes.description: Class providing interface to manage external SD Card properties, implemented as a singleton.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of hostIf_STBServiceXSDCard.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Deletes the singleton instance of hostIf_STBServiceXSDCard.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Handles setting SD Card properties (currently not implemented).

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Handles retrieving SD Card properties based on parameter name.

methods.name: getCapacity
methods.description: Retrieves the capacity of the SD Card in MB.

methods.name: getLifeElapsed
methods.description: Retrieves the life elapsed percentage of the SD Card.

methods.name: getLotID
methods.description: Retrieves the Lot ID of the SD Card.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Retrieves the manufacturer of the SD Card.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the model of the SD Card.

methods.name: getReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieves whether the SD Card is read-only.

methods.name: getSerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number of the SD Card.

methods.name: getTSBQualified
methods.description: Retrieves whether the SD Card is TSB qualified.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status string of the SD Card.

methods.name: getSDCardProperties
methods.description: Platform-specific function to retrieve SD Card properties, either via RDK storage manager or IARM bus.
